title: Ghost histogram
summary: The statistics rows stay, but with no games the histogram turns into pale placeholder bars in a typical bell shape (no numbers, hidden from screen readers) under one sentence: 'Po první hře tu uvidíte, kolik odpovědí z osmi obvykle najdete.'
tradeoffs: The zero rows above still read as an empty report; the placeholder shape could be mistaken for real data at a glance.
